svg.title: One session, request by request
svg.desc: Two bar charts of input tokens per request, one session per tool. Most requests read nearly all their input from cache. In Claude Code, a model switch and the request after /compact processed a large part again. In Codex, the model switch, the switch back, /compact and a 35-minute break did.
